parameters.query: SELECT t.id, t.name, t.scoring_pin, (t.organizer_user_id = viewer.id) AS is_owner, (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('user_id', u.id, 'name', u.name, 'phone', u.phone)) FROM tournament_scorers sc JOIN app_users u ON u.id = sc.user_id WHERE sc.tournament_id = t.id) AS scorers FROM tournaments t JOIN app_users viewer ON viewer.phone = $1 WHERE t.code = $2
